messages.en: That company has offered me a job. I want to think it over first.
That's great! Ask about the pay and working hours first. Don't just go by the job title.
We finally managed to hit this month's target after all!
Great! I've already checked the numbers. Coffee's on you tomorrow!

senses.en_definition: To try to find or obtain someone or something.
To deliberately provoke trouble or devise excuses or pretexts.

messages.en: I'm still looking for a job. Are there any openings where you work?
I think there might be one in admin. Send me your CV first, and I'll check with HR.
Where did you put the house keys? I'm about to head out.
I haven't found them yet. I'm looking in the living room.
